description: Start or refresh the Telbase session that `telbase vercel`, `telbase gcloud` and `telbase db` use, and write its files under ~/.telbase. Returns the session's org prefix, expiry, file paths and launcher commands, never the token. The launchers refresh the session themselves; call this to check it or after switching org.

refresh.description: Start a new session even if the current one has time left.

name: get_session
